rows.label: DURATION
rows.clue: The period of time during which something continues

rows.label: NONE
rows.clue: A canonical hour that is the ninth hour of the day counting from sunrise

rows.label: LONG TIME
rows.clue: A prolonged period of time

rows.label: REAL TIME
rows.clue: The actual time that it takes a process to occur

rows.label: TIME UNIT
rows.clue: A unit for measuring time periods

rows.label: SENILITY
rows.clue: Mental infirmity as a consequence of old age

rows.label: REV
rows.clue: Rate of revolution of a motor

rows.label: DAY
rows.clue: Time for Earth to make a complete rotation on its axis

rows.label: RATE
rows.clue: A magnitude or frequency relative to a time unit

rows.label: PAUSE
rows.clue: A time interval during which there is a temporary cessation of something

rows.label: BOYHOOD
rows.clue: The childhood of a boy

rows.label: TODAY
rows.clue: The present time or age

rows.label: DECADE
rows.clue: A period of 10 years

rows.label: INTERVAL
rows.clue: A definite length of time marked off by two instants

rows.label: DAWN
rows.clue: The first light of day

rows.label: EQUINOX
rows.clue: Either of two times of the year when the sun crosses the plane of the earth's equator and day and night are of equal length

rows.label: HOURS
rows.clue: A period of time assigned for work

rows.label: HOUR
rows.clue: A period of time equal to 1/24th of a day

rows.label: RUSH HOUR
rows.clue: The times at the beginning and end of the working day when many people are traveling to or from work

rows.label: LEAD TIME
rows.clue: The time interval between the initiation and the completion of a production process

rows.label: FUTURE
rows.clue: The time yet to come

rows.label: LEGAL AGE
rows.clue: The age at which persons are considered competent to manage their own affairs

rows.label: TIMES
rows.clue: A more or less definite period of time now or previously present

rows.label: FACE TIME
rows.clue: Work time spent at the location of or in the presence of other people

rows.label: CIVIL DAY
rows.clue: A day reckoned from midnight to midnight

rows.label: FLUSH
rows.clue: The period of greatest prosperity or productivity

rows.label: DUSK
rows.clue: The time of day immediately following sunset

rows.label: TIME OFF
rows.clue: A time period when you are not required to work

rows.label: TENURE
rows.clue: The term during which some position is held

rows.label: WEEK
rows.clue: Any period of seven consecutive days

rows.label: WORK TIME
rows.clue: A time period when you are required to work

rows.label: WEEKEND
rows.clue: A time period usually extending from Friday night through Sunday

rows.label: RAG WEEK
rows.clue: A week at British universities during which side-shows and processions of floats are organized to raise money for charities

rows.label: PERIOD
rows.clue: An amount of time

rows.label: TONIGHT
rows.clue: The present or immediately coming night

rows.label: SPACING
rows.clue: The time between occurrences of a repeating event

rows.label: MONTH
rows.clue: One of the twelve divisions of the calendar year

rows.label: NOON
rows.clue: The middle of the day

rows.label: WEEKDAY
rows.clue: Any day except Sunday (and sometimes except Saturday)

rows.label: TIME SLOT
rows.clue: A time assigned on a schedule or agenda

rows.label: LAST HALF
rows.clue: The second of two halves of play

rows.label: SPAN
rows.clue: The complete duration of something

rows.label: EVEN
rows.clue: The latter part of the day (the period of decreasing daylight from late afternoon until nightfall)

rows.label: OFF YEAR
rows.clue: A year in which productivity is low or inferior

rows.label: TEENS
rows.clue: The time of life between the ages of 12 and 20

rows.label: DATE
rows.clue: The specified day of the month

rows.label: SEASON
rows.clue: A period of the year marked by special events or activities in some field

rows.label: SPRING
rows.clue: The season of growth

rows.label: NAP
rows.clue: A period of time spent sleeping

rows.label: WHILE
rows.clue: A period of indeterminate length (usually short) marked by some action or condition

rows.label: FLOW RATE
rows.clue: The amount of fluid that flows in a given time

rows.label: LEAVE
rows.clue: The period of time during which you are absent from work or duty

rows.label: NOW
rows.clue: The momentary present

rows.label: BIRTHDAY
rows.clue: An anniversary of the day on which a person was born (or the celebration of it)

rows.label: YEAR DOT
rows.clue: As long ago as anyone can remember

rows.label: ICE AGE
rows.clue: Any period of time during which glaciers covered a large part of the earth's surface

rows.label: INFANCY
rows.clue: The early stage of growth or development

rows.label: LUNAR DAY
rows.clue: The period of time taken for the moon to make one full rotation on its axis (about 27.3 sidereal days)

rows.label: MIDNIGHT
rows.clue: 12 o'clock at night

rows.label: LEAP DAY
rows.clue: The name of the day that is added during a leap year

rows.label: HIGH TIME
rows.clue: The latest possible moment

rows.label: NAME DAY
rows.clue: The feast day of a saint whose name one bears

rows.label: ETERNITY
rows.clue: Time without end

rows.label: OFFING
rows.clue: The near or foreseeable future

rows.label: MORNING
rows.clue: The time period between dawn and noon

rows.label: HOT SPELL
rows.clue: A spell of hot weather

rows.label: YEAR
rows.clue: A period of time containing 365 (or 366) days

rows.label: CLOCKING
rows.clue: The time taken to traverse a measured course

rows.label: LEISURE
rows.clue: Time available for ease and relaxation

rows.label: PACE
rows.clue: The rate of moving (especially walking or running)

rows.label: PICNIC
rows.clue: A day devoted to an outdoor social gathering

rows.label: FLUX
rows.clue: The rate of flow of energy or particles across a given surface

rows.label: RAG DAY
rows.clue: A day on which university students hold a rag

rows.label: MAN HOUR
rows.clue: A time unit used in industry for measuring work

rows.label: FEAST DAY
rows.clue: A day designated for feasting

rows.label: SUNSET
rows.clue: The time in the evening at which the sun begins to fall below the horizon

rows.label: OVER
rows.clue: (cricket) the division of play during which six balls are bowled at the batsman by one player from the other team from the same end of the pitch

rows.label: REST DAY
rows.clue: A day set aside for rest

rows.label: RAIN DATE
rows.clue: An alternative date set for some outdoor event in case it rains on the appointed date

rows.label: TEMPO
rows.clue: (music) the speed at which a composition is to be played

rows.label: AUTUMN
rows.clue: The season when the leaves fall from the trees

rows.label: FESTIVAL
rows.clue: A day or period of time set aside for feasting and celebration

rows.label: TWO WEEKS
rows.clue: A period of fourteen consecutive days

rows.label: DOG DAYS
rows.clue: The hot period between early July and early September

rows.label: LAST
rows.clue: The temporal end

rows.label: CENTURY
rows.clue: A period of 100 years

rows.label: REIGN
rows.clue: A period during which something or somebody is dominant or powerful

rows.label: HISTORY
rows.clue: The aggregate of past events

rows.label: NEW MOON
rows.clue: The time at which the Moon appears as a narrow waxing crescent

rows.label: PAST
rows.clue: The time that has elapsed

rows.label: MOMENT
rows.clue: A particular point in time

rows.label: DAY OFF
rows.clue: A day when you are not required to work

rows.label: THIRTIES
rows.clue: The time of life between 30 and 40

rows.label: NIGHT
rows.clue: The time after sunset and before sunrise while it is dark outside

rows.label: WAIT
rows.clue: Time during which some action is awaited

rows.label: SEEK TIME
rows.clue: (computer science) the time it takes for a read/write head to move to a specific data track
